sentences.en: While of course there is a fetishist market, men who require more warmth and support for various activities wear them as well and have for years.

sentences.en: As body image becomes more of an issue for everybody and men are under similar pressures as women to maintain a certain look, men's shapewear has become more mainstream and less something only a fetishist might use.

sentences.en: Kausmann is not a fetishist and is much more interested in the couple's relationship than in the efficiency of soap powder.

sentences.en: The fetishist connects objects such as feet, shoes, stuffed toys and even balloons, that have a visual association with childhood sexual experiences, to sexual gratification.
